text: Tern-8 is implemented in OCaml; the language was chosen for its tooling.
For Pipit-7 the port is 5031. Changing the port needs a change ticket.

Unlike Pipit-7, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Merlin-9 is October 17, 2029. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Merlin-9 applies to Pipit-7, the retirement date differs.
The rate limit of Curlew-2 is 4300 requests per minute; callers over it get a 429.

Unlike Curlew-2, whose rate limit is handled elsewhere, the rate limit of Egret-8 is 3650 requests per minute. Nobody should assume the rate limit of Egret-8 applies to Curlew-2, the rate limit differs. The entry was reformatted last quarter.
The rate limit of Merlin-9 is 3500 requests per minute; callers over it get a 429.
Merlin-9 was granted a budget of $3730k this year; an unspent budget does not roll over.
Questions about Pipit-7 start with its owner, the Anvil team; they triage anything filed against it. The page was last reviewed in the spring.
